metadata.status_rationale: ATLAS demonstrates exceptional algorithmic accuracy and deterministic safety under benchmark conditions, but operates as an in-memory research/evaluation harness. It lacks an HTTP service layer, fail-closed authentication middleware, request timeouts, structured logging, containerization, and incremental indexing necessary for enterprise production deployment.

top_5_production_risks.risk: Absence of HTTP/gRPC service layer, health endpoints, and process concurrency controls prevents enterprise integration and deployment.
Completely unbounded synchronous PyTorch model inference with zero timeouts or circuit breakers creates immediate susceptibility to thread starvation and process hang.
Stage 2 authorization check bypasses role/dept/user ACL validation when credentials are None (unauthenticated caller), and defaults missing tenant to NovaStack.
Missing Dockerfile, CI/CD pipelines, and outdated requirements.txt (unpinned torch/transformers) prevents reproducible container builds.
Standard logging module is 100% absent across codebase; zero Prometheus metrics or OpenTelemetry tracing prevents operational monitoring and incident triage.

findings.name: API/Service Reliability
findings.current_behavior: ATLAS exists strictly as an in-memory Python library without any HTTP/gRPC API service (FastAPI, Flask, gRPC). Queries are executed via local benchmark scripts.
findings.why_it_matters: Enterprise client applications cannot query ATLAS over standard network protocols. No ASGI/WSGI process supervision, health probes (/healthz, /ready), or connection pooling exist.
findings.code_evidence: Zero occurrences of FastAPI, Flask, uvicorn, or network socket listeners in src/. End-to-end execution requires manual class instantiation.
findings.recommended_fix: Build a production FastAPI service (src/novastack/service/api.py) with Pydantic request/response models, /healthz and /ready endpoints, and graceful shutdown handlers.
findings.test_required: tests/test_api_service.py using httpx.AsyncClient verifying endpoint schemas, concurrency, and health checks.

findings.name: Authentication and Authorization Enforcement
findings.current_behavior: Missing tenant defaults silently to 'TENANT-NOVASTACK'. ACL checks skip validation when user_role, user_department, or user_id is None, allowing unauthenticated callers to access restricted documents.
findings.why_it_matters: Violates zero-trust security. Any unauthenticated query omitting user_role bypasses role-based restrictions on restricted documents.
findings.code_evidence: Line 207: user_tenant = eval_case.get('tenant_id') or 'TENANT-NOVASTACK'. Line 343: if perms.allowed_roles and user_role is not None: if user_role not in perms.allowed_roles: is_auth = False.
findings.recommended_fix: Enforce fail-closed authorization: reject missing tenant_id immediately; enforce is_auth = False whenever perms.allowed_roles is non-empty and user_role is None or unauthorized.
findings.test_required: tests/test_auth_fail_closed.py verifying that unauthenticated requests (user_role=None) are strictly denied restricted records.

findings.name: Tenant Isolation
findings.current_behavior: All tenants reside in a single shared index and vector matrix. Isolation relies on pre-scoring dictionary filtering and Stage 2 post-filtering. VALID_TENANTS is hardcoded in ingestion.py.
findings.why_it_matters: If caller accidentally passes filters=None, foreign tenant records enter candidate ranking and crowd out legitimate tenant documents before Stage 2 exclusion. Static tenant set prevents dynamic tenant onboarding.
findings.code_evidence: BM25Index and DenseIndex store self.chunks across all tenants in one array. ingestion.py:32 hardcodes VALID_TENANTS.
findings.recommended_fix: Partition indices per tenant or make tenant_id a required positional parameter at the index search interface. Implement dynamic tenant registry.
findings.test_required: tests/test_tenant_partitioning.py verifying that index instances strictly isolate tenant memory spaces.

findings.name: Ingestion Failure Handling
findings.current_behavior: In strict=True, any single invalid record aborts the entire batch. In strict=False, validation errors are logged but invalid records are still normalized and emitted in output search documents.
findings.why_it_matters: Batch-abort halts ETL synchronization; non-strict mode pollutes search documents with invalid schemas, dangling references, or temporal violations.
findings.code_evidence: Lines 483-487 raises ValueError; lines 499-502 calls normalize_source_record(r) for all records unconditionally in non-strict mode.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement partial batch ingestion with an isolated Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ). Valid records are committed; invalid records are routed to DLQ with detailed error traces.
findings.test_required: tests/test_ingestion_dlq.py verifying partial ingestion where valid records commit and invalid records route to DLQ.

findings.name: Indexing Failure Handling
findings.current_behavior: Indices are static, all-or-nothing in-memory structures. Incremental document indexing is unsupported. Corrupted index file on disk raises ValueError and leaves system inoperative.
findings.why_it_matters: Cannot add, update, or delete enterprise documents dynamically without rebuilding the entire corpus index. Index corruption causes catastrophic startup failure.
findings.code_evidence: DenseIndex and BM25Index lack incremental add/update/delete methods. DenseIndex.load raises ValueError on count or ID mismatch.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement AtomicIndexManager supporting blue/green index swapping and transactional index reloads; integrate production vector database for incremental updates.
findings.test_required: tests/test_atomic_index_swap.py verifying zero-downtime index cutover and rollback on corrupt index files.

findings.name: Document/Version/Lifecycle Handling
findings.current_behavior: Stage 5 correctly resolves supersession, deprecation, and drafts among retrieved candidates, but cannot detect if a candidate was superseded by a document that was not retrieved in Top-50.
findings.why_it_matters: If a newer v2.0 document is missed during lexical/dense retrieval, an obsolete v1.0 document is returned as active canonical truth.
findings.code_evidence: Stage 5 inspects supersedes_id and parent_id locally on candidate items, without querying a global supersession catalog.
findings.recommended_fix: Maintain a global pre-computed supersession lookup table and purge superseded documents at ingestion/indexing time.
findings.test_required: tests/test_global_supersession.py verifying that an obsolete document is excluded even if its replacement is absent from candidates.

findings.name: Stale-Data Behavior
findings.current_behavior: Deterministic Stage 6 gate checks valid_from and valid_until ISO 8601 bounds against evaluation/query timestamp. Passed red-team audit with 0 stale resurrections.
findings.why_it_matters: Complies with temporal validity invariants and prevents expired data leaks.
findings.code_evidence: Stage 6 lines 510-545 correctly parses timestamps and excludes expired documents.
findings.recommended_fix: N/A (System functions as specified).
findings.test_required: Already verified via test_security_invariants_preserved_with_production_defaults and Phase 4K-F suite.

findings.name: Retries and Timeouts
findings.current_behavior: Zero timeouts, deadlines, or retry mechanisms anywhere in the codebase. PyTorch model.generate() runs synchronously and indefinitely on CPU/GPU.
findings.why_it_matters: A slow query, memory thrashing, or GPU deadlock will hang the worker process forever, causing cascading thread pool exhaustion and denial of service.
findings.code_evidence: src/novastack/generation.py:411: with torch.no_grad(): outputs = self.model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, ...). Zero timeout parameters.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement execution deadlines using asyncio timeouts or thread-pool timeouts with stopping criteria, coupled with circuit breakers.
findings.test_required: tests/test_timeout_circuit_breaker.py verifying that slow generation triggers a controlled timeout exception and falls back to safe abstention.

findings.name: Logging
findings.current_behavior: Standard Python logging library is 100% absent across src/. Components use print() statements or accumulate strings in diagnostic dictionaries.
findings.why_it_matters: SRE and DevOps teams cannot monitor system logs in CloudWatch/Datadog, cannot filter by severity level (INFO/WARN/ERROR), and lack correlation IDs for request tracking.
findings.code_evidence: Zero occurrences of 'import logging' or 'logging.getLogger' across all 37 Python files in src/novastack/.
findings.recommended_fix: Introduce a centralized structured logging module (novastack.logger) emitting JSON logs with correlation IDs, timestamps, and severity levels.
findings.test_required: tests/test_structured_logging.py verifying log emission, level filtering, and correlation ID attachment.

findings.name: Observability
findings.current_behavior: Internal diagnostic dicts are generated, but no Prometheus metrics (/metrics) or OpenTelemetry distributed tracing spans are exported.
findings.why_it_matters: No operational visibility into real-time request rates, latency percentiles (P95/P99), abstention spikes, cache hits, or GPU memory consumption.
findings.code_evidence: Zero Prometheus client or OpenTelemetry SDK integrations in src/.
findings.recommended_fix: Instrument all pipeline stages with OpenTelemetry spans and export Prometheus metrics for query latency, throughput, and abstention rates.
findings.test_required: tests/test_prometheus_metrics.py verifying metric increments and trace propagation.

findings.name: Latency Measurement
findings.current_behavior: Fine-grained latency measurement using time.perf_counter() across all 8 internal resolution stages and generation phases.
findings.why_it_matters: Provides microsecond-level timing transparency for evidence ingestion, authorization, deduplication, lifecycle, authority, and inference.
findings.code_evidence: latencies dictionary populated with ingestion_ms, authorization_ms, deduplication_ms, etc., and generation_latency_ms.
findings.recommended_fix: N/A (Exposing to external Prometheus histogram is covered under Observability).
findings.test_required: Already verified in test_canonical_baseline.py.

findings.name: Model/Token/Cost Measurement
findings.current_behavior: Accurately measures input_tokens and output_tokens and limits context via budgeter. Does not calculate dollar cost or enforce per-tenant token quotas.
findings.why_it_matters: Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS requires commercial metering, cost allocation, and rate-limiting to prevent billing overruns.
findings.code_evidence: AnswerResult stores input_tokens and output_tokens; no pricing tables or quota enforcement classes exist.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a token quota limiter and billing estimator module calculating cost per tenant query.
findings.test_required: tests/test_token_quota.py verifying rejection when tenant token quota is exceeded.

findings.name: Configuration Management
findings.current_behavior: Configuration uses clean Python dataclasses, but all parameters are hardcoded in source files without environment variable (os.environ) overrides.
findings.why_it_matters: Deploying in Kubernetes/container environments requires rebuilding or mounting code to change production flags rather than passing environment variables.
findings.code_evidence: EvidenceResolverConfig, DenseConfig, BM25Config default parameters are hardcoded without os.getenv() checks.
findings.recommended_fix: Integrate pydantic-settings or os.getenv overrides for all configuration dataclasses (e.g. ATLAS_QUERY_AWARE_AUTHORITY=true).
findings.test_required: tests/test_env_config.py verifying environment variable precedence over defaults.

findings.name: Test Coverage and Test Organization
findings.current_behavior: Exemplary test coverage across unit, integration, ablation, benchmark, and red-team security suites. 598/598 tests passing.
findings.why_it_matters: Guarantees mathematical correctness, regression resistance, and lineage verification.
findings.code_evidence: All test files in tests/ execute cleanly in pytest.
findings.recommended_fix: N/A (Add API service tests once service layer is implemented).
findings.test_required: Already verified via pytest tests/ -v.

findings.name: Deterministic/Reproducible Evaluation
findings.current_behavior: Frozen canonical baseline with greedy decoding (do_sample=False) and fixed random seeding ensures bit-for-bit reproducibility.
findings.why_it_matters: Provides gold-standard scientific evaluation and deterministic certification.
findings.code_evidence: artifacts/phase_4k_canonical_baseline.json and generation.py greedy decoding flags.
findings.recommended_fix: N/A.
findings.test_required: Already verified in test_canonical_baseline.py.

findings.name: Error Handling
findings.current_behavior: Domain errors (conflicts, missing evidence) result in safe abstentions. However, unexpected system exceptions (OOM, missing files, malformed tensors) crash the execution thread without standardized error formatting.
findings.why_it_matters: Unhandled exceptions produce 500 crashes and unformatted stack traces in client logs.
findings.code_evidence: Absence of top-level try/except wrappers in GroundedAnswerGenerator.generate_answer.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement an RFC 7807 Problem Details error handler mapping runtime exceptions to structured error responses and safe fallback abstentions.
findings.test_required: tests/test_runtime_error_fallback.py verifying graceful error handling on synthetic OOM.

findings.name: Rollback/Recovery
findings.current_behavior: Feature flag rollback is documented and instantaneous via a single boolean toggle. However, no automated deployment rollback or vector index snapshot recovery exists.
findings.why_it_matters: Requires manual engineering intervention to revert misconfigurations or corrupted indices in production.
findings.code_evidence: docs/PHASE_4K_G_B_PROMOTION.md specifies manual code edits for rollback.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement versioned artifact releases and automated canary rollback scripts.
findings.test_required: CI/CD automated rollback integration tests.

findings.name: Deployment Readiness
findings.current_behavior: requirements.txt has not been updated since Phase 1C and only lists pytest. No Dockerfile, docker-compose, or CI/CD workflow exists. PyTorch, Transformers, and SentenceTransformers are unpinned.
findings.why_it_matters: The platform cannot be reproducibly built, containerized, or deployed to Kubernetes. Clean environment installations will fail.
findings.code_evidence: requirements.txt contains only 'pytest>=7.0'. No Dockerfile or pyproject.toml in repository.
findings.recommended_fix: Create modern pyproject.toml with pinned dependencies (torch, transformers, sentence-transformers, numpy, etc.), multi-stage Dockerfile, and GitHub Actions CI workflow.
findings.test_required: tests/test_docker_build.sh verifying container build and startup.

findings.name: Data Integrity
findings.current_behavior: Static corpus data integrity is rigorously verified and immutable. For dynamic multi-tenant production, flat JSON storage lacks ACID transactions and concurrency safety.
findings.why_it_matters: Concurrent write operations by multiple workers in production would cause file corruption.
findings.code_evidence: Corpus files are stored as plain JSON on local disk.
findings.recommended_fix: Migrate dynamic operational records to an ACID relational or document database with row-level locks.
findings.test_required: tests/test_concurrent_data_writes.py.

findings.name: Operational Risks
findings.current_behavior: ATLAS operates as a stateful, in-memory monolithic Python process holding large vector arrays and Gemma-3-1B model weights in worker memory.
findings.why_it_matters: High blast radius: a crash brings down the entire pipeline. Multi-worker scaling multiplies VRAM/RAM linearly. Long cold-start times.
findings.code_evidence: Each worker process instantiates DenseIndex and loads Gemma model into memory.
findings.recommended_fix: Decouple into dedicated microservices: Vector Retrieval Service (stateless/vector DB) and Generation Service (dedicated vLLM/TGI inference backend).
findings.test_required: Load and stress testing across independent service tiers.

recommended_implementation_order.phase: Phase 4M: API Service & Fail-Closed Security Hardening
recommended_implementation_order.focus: Build FastAPI service layer (/query, /healthz, /ready), fix fail-closed RBAC check for None roles, enforce tenant authentication middleware.
Create pyproject.toml with pinned dependencies, multi-stage Dockerfile with GPU/CPU support, and CI/CD GitHub Actions workflow.
Wrap PyTorch inference in asynchronous timeout contexts, implement circuit breakers, and add RFC 7807 structured error responses.
Introduce centralized JSON logging with correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry tracing spans, and Prometheus metric exports.

recommended_implementation_order.phase: Phase 4Q: Ingestion DLQ & Dynamic Index Management
recommended_implementation_order.focus: Implement partial batch ingestion with Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ), dynamic tenant partitioning, and atomic index swapping.
